title: Production launch and post-release sweep: Vercel deploy, card engravings, How to Play, UI fixes
description: Post-milestone work requested by Bob after M6: production deployment on Vercel with a custom domain, real art on the myth-buster cards, three UI fixes (nav badge, map label halos, timeline spacing), and a How to Play guide. All shipped, verified and live on 2026-10-20.
notes:
Shipped and live 2026-10-20:
1) Deployment: Vercel project bobthegeeks-projects/the-great-mortality, Git-connected (pushes to main deploy to production). vercel.json sets the Vite build, dist output, and revalidate headers for sw.js and manifest.webmanifest. Custom domain thegreatmortality.crazymutt.tech added in Vercel and a GoDaddy CNAME (thegreatmortality -> e0cb207914629a3f.vercel-dns-017.com); DNS verified, SSL issued automatically, service worker registers and the PWA installs from the new domain.
2) Card engravings: all eight myth-buster cards now show public-domain historical works, vendored offline in public/cards (grayscale, 4:3 framing, multiply-blended like pasted prints): Paul Fuerst Dr. Doctor Schnabel von Rom (1656), Holbein The Physician (Dance of Death, c. 1526/38), Delleani Ring a Ring o Roses (1885), Amman Der Seifensieder (Staendebuch, 1568), Black Rat natural-history plate (DPLA), Schedel flagellants (Nuremberg Chronicle, 1493), Brunetti Il Lazzaretto di Milano (1631), Hooke flea (Micrographia, 1665). Attribution in CREDITS.md and the paused sheet; unit test guards every card image.
3) UI fixes: the Evidence clue badge no longer clips (nav tiles moved into wrappers so the badge overhangs; End month padding and tile padding/gap/tracking retuned so Evidence and Chronicles labels also fit at 11-inch and mini widths); map town labels gained a paper halo (paint-order stroke with a --map-halo color that lerps with the darkening theme) so roads no longer run through text; the chronicles timeline sits 10px clear of the tabs and the pin titles wrap (12px, max 98px) so they stop colliding.
4) How to Play: six-slide guide with real game captures (public/howto), auto-opens on the first game start and is marked seen on show; always reachable from the map question-mark button, the Paused sheet, and dev mode (Show how-to). Covered by the howto.spec E2E (first-run open, slide walk, reopen, no re-nag) plus screenshots/how-to.
Verification at close: 161 unit tests (24 files) and 45 Playwright WebKit E2E green; typecheck and static build green; production serving the HEAD bundle. Closing as complete.

title: Milestone 6: Verification
description: Playwright on WebKit at all three iPad sizes in both orientations covering ADDENDUM section 10 flows, plus a final pass checking every screen against the design canvas.
notes:
M6 implemented: a verification spec running the full journey (opening → first month → Evidence Board verdict states → end screen) on WebKit at all three iPad sizes in both orientations, asserting Fontenera stays fully visible inside the map leaf, the page body never scrolls, and touch targets hold 44pt; plus a service-worker edition test that builds twice, serves through vite preview and proves the new-edition toast appears and reloads only on request; plus a final pass of every screen against the design canvas. Canvas findings fixed in this pass: the opening narration is cumulative (previous + current full, next at 55%), progress dots sit inline before the uppercase hint, the three gold window dots moved to the skyline, the moon dark side blends with the sky; the map viewBox recentered 130→170 and the offshore galley marker moved 300→440 because the slice crop clipped Fontenera label at 11-inch and 13-inch landscape and the marker almost everywhere on landscape; verdict sheets gained the QUESTION-numeral kicker, the argued theory as a heading, the ink Pin button and an italic Not-yet line; the event sheet footer and button sit side by side; the reckoning bars are solid ink and the footnote gains the Fontenera-spared line when spared; ending stats sit between rules; lens chips are rectangular and its button full width; board/cards/codex empty states added. Canvas-only copy not adopted, per the standing rule: the ships-held status suffix, the galley-hold countdown and the extra conclusion sentence on the wrong-verdict clue. Verification: 159 unit tests + 42 Playwright WebKit E2E green; typecheck and static build green. Awaiting Bob review.
M6 verified: the full journey (opening, first month, Evidence Board verdict states, end screen) passes on WebKit at all three iPad sizes in both orientations; per viewport the tests assert Fontenera stays fully visible inside the map leaf, the page body never scrolls, and key touch targets hold 44pt; the service-worker edition test builds twice, serves through vite preview, and proves the new-edition toast appears and reloads only on request; and the screen-by-screen pass against the design canvas was completed with its findings fixed in the c04de6f commit (see that commit and the M6 notes above). title: Milestone 5: PWA and polish
description: manifest.webmanifest, versioned service worker with new edition update prompt, Add to Home Screen hint before first game, navigator.storage.persist(), progress backup and restore codes UI, splash, Paused sheet polish, reduced motion, dev mode (compass tapped 7 times) with in-browser harness.
notes:
M5 implemented: manifest (standalone, any orientation, icons 192/512), index.html iOS meta plus apple-touch-icon 180 and theme color, splash (inline critical CSS, wax seal, stays 400ms minimum), versioned service worker (build-stamped cache name and full precache asset list; cache-first with navigation fallback; "A new edition of the ledger is ready" toast with Reload; user-driven skipWaiting, never an automatic reload), navigator.storage.persist() in standalone, Add to Home Screen hint before the first game (Show me expands the instruction; Later warns once that progress will not carry over, then dismisses; persisted), Paused sheet polish (This device reset, Progress backup with copy and restore codes plus a selectable fallback field, Credits row), reduced-motion sweep (crossfades off, title card, lens bloom, galleys, town pulse as a static gold ring), dev mode behind seven compass taps within 3 seconds (seed view and seeded new game, skip to month N, run to the end, live town table S/I/P/D/R and rats, Lens access regardless of unlock, unlock all, reset all, fire the scripted event, pin any clue, in-browser balance harness with a summary table). Verification: 159 unit tests + 29 Playwright WebKit E2E green; typecheck and static build green; the production build boots, clears the splash and registers the service worker (checked against vite preview). Rulings: the service worker registers only in production builds; the update toast never reloads on its own; the compass moved from (1100,60) to (1035,70) so the slice crop cannot take the dev entry off-screen at the reference landscape size; progress codes carry the full save document with checksum and friendly errors; the a2hs dismissal survives Reset all progress; dev skip stops at a run end; dev-fired events label the current month. Awaiting Bob review before M6.
Bob reviewed and approved 2026-10-20; closing this milestone.

title: Milestone 4: Story and endings
description: Opening (5 narration lines, name picker, reroll), return visit screen, advisors and their schedule, Fear and Blame event (README 2p + addendum copy exactly), all three endings with generated epithet citations, Physician Lens reveal and overlay, end-screen navigation chain.
design:
M4 plan (from README 2a/2b/2f/2p/2j/2k/2q/2r/2s + ADDENDUM 2/5/6/7 + sim-spec):
1) Opening (5 lines, tap/SKIP, 5 dots) -> title card + name picker (4 names + reroll rotation) -> run start (c-galleys + Ships from Caffa granted). Return visit (2b) when a save/history exists: Continue + summary "Name · Month Year · N towns healthy", New game, mystery discs, footer stats + Settings (Paused sheet works from start screen).
2) Advisor schedule: months 0-3 intros Merchant/Physician/Priest/Astrologer; m>=4 ~40% deterministic shell RNG (seeded from run.seed, engine RNG untouched); never same twice in a row; line context winter>spreading>early, no line repeats in run. Sheet 2f with portrait placeholder, offer (valid only), Thank him and no. Accepted offer applied at next month start (slots+cost; lifts free); merchant offers are lifts. Astrologer first appearance earns card VI.
3) Scripted event Fear and Blame (2p): fires per engine report.events; grants chronicle + scapegoat codex term; sheet copy verbatim from spec; after report, before advisor.
4) Endings: on run end -> finalizeOnce (as-is) then autoplayToEnd + epithet grant; overthrown/fled = full screens 2r/2s (spec copy) with stats, then See the reckoning -> 2q reckoning: survival, souls, town bars w/ 60% red line, Fontenera gold if spared, mystery discs + +N this run + New this run counts (chronicles/cards/codex), epithets chips + generated citation from top-2 actions (actionPhrases). Play again -> start; Read the chronicle -> chronicles.
5) Lens: 4th pin -> earned queue -> 2j reveal -> 2k overlay (map + legend ledger + toggles Rats/Fleas/Forms default on/on/off; rat circles from colony fraction; pneumonic opacity; spared ring only if Fontenera no burials). Lens tile opens overlay once unlocked.
6) Rulings: shell RNG deterministic per (seed,month,salt); advisor offer town = most buried else port; lifts apply next month; autoplay does not process clues/unlocks; post-run Map tab -> reckoning; peek card keeps latest advisor line; name reroll = pool rotation; flags widened to boolean|string for shell use.
notes:
M4 implemented: opening (5 narration lines with tap/skip and 5 dots) and title card with name picker (4 of 16 names, reroll rotation, steward term seen on screen one); return visit (2b) with Continue save summary, New game, mystery discs, footer stats and Settings; advisor schedule (months 0-3 intros in order, about 40% after, never twice in a row, winter/spreading/early lines without repeats, portrait placeholder, only valid offers, Thank him and no; an accepted decree issues at the start of the next month and uses a slot; merchant offers are free lifts); Fear and Blame event (2p copy verbatim including bookbinder copy correction, grants the chronicle and the scapegoat term); endings (auto-play after any ending for the reckoning numbers; overthrown and fled screens with spec copy; the reckoning: survival, souls, town bars with the 60% red line, Fontenera gold when spared, mystery discs with +N this run and New this run counts, epithet plaque with a generated citation from the two most-used actions, epithets chips; Play again and Read the chronicle); the Physicians Lens (2j reveal on the fourth pin, then the 2k overlay: dimmed map, dynamic rat colonies from the engine, flea arcs, pneumonic marks, spared ring only when Fontenera has no burials, layer toggles Rats/Fleas/Forms default on/on/off, legend copy from the spec). Verification: 155 unit tests + 21 Playwright WebKit E2E green; typecheck and static build green. Screenshots under screenshots/milestone-4 (both orientations). Rulings: shell-side advisor draws are deterministic per (seed, month) and never consume the engine RNG so the simulation stays seed-reproducible; the offer town is the most buried town else the port; merchant lifts also take effect at the start of the next month (one timing rule); auto-play does not surface clues or unlocks; the end-screen month label is captured before auto-play; the post-run Map tab returns to the reckoning; the advisor peek keeps the latest line until another advisor speaks; reroll rotates the name pool; run flags widened to boolean|string for shell bookkeeping. Awaiting Bob review before M5.
Bob reviewed and approved 2026-10-20; closing this milestone.
